Measured payoff on the epoch path (Evaluate over a 600-point grid, JMH, us/op):
  width 2s  p0.33: exact 320 vs trapezoid 570    (1.8x)
  width 2s  p0.05: exact 322 vs trapezoid 2459   (7.6x)
  width 12s p0.33: exact 311 vs trapezoid 2295   (7.4x)
  width 12s p0.05: exact 313 vs trapezoid 14270  (45.6x)
The exact column is flat at ~315us across every width and precision — the trapezoid costs O(width/precision) kernel evaluations per sample, the primitive costs two antiderivative evaluations.
